description: Open-source music foundation model for generating complete songs from text, lyric prompts, and style tags, with controllable song structure and broad multilingual lyric conditioning.

request.name: duration_sec
request.description: Maximum generated audio duration in seconds; must be positive when set; default 120.

request.name: temperature
request.description: Audio-token sampling temperature; must be positive when set; default 1.0.

request.name: guidance_scale
request.description: MuLa classifier-free guidance scale; must be positive when set; default 1.5.

request.name: infinite_mode
request.description: Generate long outputs by splitting lyrics into bounded HeartMuLa requests.

request.name: infinite_chunk_audio_duration_ms
request.description: Maximum generated audio duration per infinite-mode chunk in milliseconds; default 240000.

request.name: seed
request.description: Generation seed for reproducible output; default 1234.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: MuLa and codec weight storage type; default native.

session.name: generator_weight_type
session.description: MuLa music-token generator weight storage type; defaults to weight_type when set, otherwise native.

session.name: codec_weight_type
session.description: Codec weight storage type; defaults to weight_type when set, otherwise native.

session.name: generator_weight_context_mb
session.description: MuLa music-token generator weight descriptor context size in MiB; default 32.

session.name: codec_weight_context_mb
session.description: Codec weight descriptor context size in MiB; default 32.

session.name: generator_constant_context_mb
session.description: MuLa music-token generator reusable constant context size in MiB; default 256.

session.name: backbone_prefill_graph_arena_mb
session.description: MuLa music-token generator backbone prefill graph arena size in MiB; default 1536.

session.name: backbone_step_graph_arena_mb
session.description: MuLa music-token generator backbone cached-step graph arena size in MiB; default 1536.

session.name: decoder_prefill_graph_arena_mb
session.description: MuLa music-token generator decoder prefill graph arena size in MiB; default 512.

session.name: decoder_step_graph_arena_mb
session.description: MuLa music-token generator decoder cached-step graph arena size in MiB; default 512.

session.name: frame_embedding_graph_arena_mb
session.description: MuLa music-token generator frame-embedding graph arena size in MiB; default 512.

session.name: flow_estimator_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Codec flow-estimator graph arena size in MiB; default 2048.

session.name: conditioning_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Codec conditioning graph arena size in MiB; default 512.

session.name: scalar_decoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Codec scalar-decoder graph arena size in MiB; default 1536.

session.name: mem_saver
session.description: Release staged runtime graphs after each request; default false.

sizes.basis: size=tree@huggingface; hf_mirror=assumed; modelscope=files API; est_vram=size+family overhead (derived)
size=tree@huggingface; hf_mirror=assumed; modelscope=files API; est_vram=report peak (docs/reports)

description.en: Open-source music foundation model for generating complete songs from text, lyric prompts, and style tags, with controllable song structure and broad multilingual lyric conditioning.
description.zh: 开源音乐基础模型，可由文本、歌词提示与风格标签生成完整歌曲，支持可控歌曲结构与广泛的多语言歌词条件。

tags.zh: 以逗号分隔的音乐标签。

duration_sec.en: Maximum generated audio duration in seconds; must be positive when set; default 120.
duration_sec.zh: 生成音频的最大时长（秒）；设置时须为正数；默认 120。

temperature.en: Audio-token sampling temperature; must be positive when set; default 1.0.
temperature.zh: 音频 token 采样温度；设置时须为正数；默认 1.0。

top_k.zh: 音频 token 的 top-k 采样上限；默认 50。

guidance_scale.en: MuLa classifier-free guidance scale; must be positive when set; default 1.5.
guidance_scale.zh: MuLa 无分类器引导强度；设置时须为正数；默认 1.5。

num_inference_steps.zh: 编解码流求解步数；默认 10。

infinite_mode.en: Generate long outputs by splitting lyrics into bounded HeartMuLa requests.
infinite_mode.zh: 把歌词拆成有上限的多个 HeartMuLa 请求，以生成较长输出。

infinite_chunk_audio_duration_ms.en: Maximum generated audio duration per infinite-mode chunk in milliseconds; default 240000.
infinite_chunk_audio_duration_ms.zh: 无限模式中每个分块生成音频的最大时长（毫秒）；默认 240000。

seed.en: Generation seed for reproducible output; default 1234.
seed.zh: 用于可复现输出的生成随机种子；默认 1234。
